content.title: France's Political Mainstream Faces Wipe-Out at Presidential Election
content.caption: The article discusses the political landscape leading up to the French presidential election, focusing on the dominance of hard-right and hard-left candidates and the lack of a clear alternative.

slides.heading: France's Political Mainstream Faces Wipe-Out at Presidential Election
slides.text: The article discusses the political landscape leading up to the French presidential election, focusing on the dominance of hard-right and hard-left candidates and the lack of a clear alternative.

slides.heading: Dominance of Hard-Right and Hard-Left Candidates
slides.text: Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon dominate the polls, with no clear alternative to their dominance.
slides.image_search_query: Dominance of hard-right and hard-left candidates France

slides.heading: Lack of Clear Alternative
slides.text: The lack of a clear alternative to Le Pen and Mélenchon is due to personal rivalries, lack of preparation, and differing political visions.
